why: PROP-EXEC fix-forward #9: the blind positions / orders reader. Live test #13987 filled 0.01 SOLUSD (operator screenshot: SOLUSD | Buy | 0.01 | em-dash P&L | TP 120.18 | SL 117.80 | id | fill 118.94 | current | date) while every read returned 0 positions, 7 minutes later included (#13992). Measured cause, same as the watchlist in #13898/#13908: the terminal renders every grid as a HEADER table with zero rows of its own plus a separate header-less BODY table, and EXTRACT_TABLES_JS only recorded headed tables. (1) A shared helper pairs a headed table that has no rows with the first header-less table that follows it (before the next headed table), only when that table is empty or its first row has exactly as many cells as headers; a headed table with its own rows is self-contained. EXTRACT_TABLES_JS and ROW_ACTION_JS (the watched close / cancel / edit path) both use it, so the reader and the row controls see the same rows. (2) Chart-overlay guard on row controls (operator 2026-09-29): the control must be boxed inside its own <tr> and nowhere near a canvas, else refused. (3) The quote plausibility rules (#13908: cell count = header count, 0 < bid <= ask, spread <= 2%) now apply on every path, since a headed table's rows can come from a paired body. (4) dump-tables also prints the pairing facts and the first row's controls. Replicas: the operator's column layout as split tables reads one OPEN bracketed position (em-dash P&L parses to None); an empty body is truly empty; a body with the wrong column count is not paired; flatten finds the row's control and refuses the same control pulled out of its row; the position id is masked in the dump. Tier 2: read path + the row-control locator on a funded account; no sizing, guard-threshold or risk change; no click added.
